cover_letter_text:
I am applying for the Civil Works Project Officer role advertised on the Yarra City Council careers site. Your advert says the Development and Civil Engineering team oversees and inspects reinstatement works on Council's roads and footpaths, and that this role scopes those works and checks them against Council standards.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on construction sites in the Philippines. As project-in-charge engineer I coordinated 10 to 15 workers each day, carried out site inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring, and escalated issues that needed corrective action. As field engineer I assisted with site inspections and quality checks, coordinated with subcontractors and suppliers, and prepared site and progress reports. In February 2026 I completed the Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, where I designed road geometry and pavement systems, lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries and designed around existing services.

I am based in Melton VIC and can start two weeks after an offer. Full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa), no sponsorship needed. I hold a White Card and a full Victorian driver's licence, with my own reliable transport. Could we arrange a call about the role?
Marc Masarate
